thread:
ravi: heads-up — late-night alerts for ap-southeast1. small trainer pods got evicted en masse when a handful of racks hit ToR egress throttling. packing efficiency tanked.

marie: saw it. kube events show nic egress throttle then immediate pod preempts. fractional gpu jobs are the worst here since they land spread out.

ravi: exact event: 
````
Warning Eviction 2m kubelet pod sandbox evicted: nic egress quota exceeded
Normal Preempted 1m scheduler Preempted pod uid=... (gpu=0.25)
````

zhou: quick ideas: 1) scoring penalty for node.egress_5m > T, 2) soft-label nodes first then taint if sustained, 3) small burst pool for low-priority fractional workloads to absorb churn.

marie: prefer soft-label + hysteresis to avoid flip-flop. also gate penalties per-rack so a noisy ToR doesn't poison global scheduler decisions.

ravi: telemetry reqs: node.egress_5m, rack.egress_pct, fractional_contiguous_slices, preempt_rate_by_rack. need these before canary.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-8321 to prototype egress penalty plugin and burst-pool autoscaler.

zhou: plan: prototype plugin in staging (1d), add labels/controller to escalate (1d), add dashboards and a 5% scheduler canary. Abort if preempt_rate increases >5%.

marie: cost note — burst pool autoscaled looks like <1% steady spend increase for the region, worst-case 4-6% if always hot. include TTLs.

ravi: thanks — pushing brief runbook and will follow up with staging metrics.
